name: RSI-overbought + funding-froth fade — short the over-extended, over-levered top (perp)
rationale: ECONOMIC MECHANISM (a SHORT fade distinct from theory-mean-reversion-fade-of-upside [bb_z+adx, no leverage gauge] and from funding-contrarian-crash-filter [funding+runup+vol, no RSI]; this pairs an RSI overbought extreme with a funding-froth confirmation): the safest place to fade an up-move is where BOTH the price is over-extended (RSI overbought) AND the leverage is crowded long (funding frothy positive) — the over-extension says the move is stretched, the funding says the crowd is levered into it and a small reversal will force long liquidations that accelerate the pullback. Shorting overbought ALONE is the trap that gets run over in a strong leveraged uptrend; requiring positive-funding froth means we only fade tops the leverage crowd is exposed to. This is a perp SHORT (direction -1): stop ABOVE entry, take-profit BELOW. Entry: rsi above a fitted overbought ceiling AND funding_rate above a fitted froth floor (crowded long). Exit: rsi crosses DOWN through a normalization threshold (over-extension worked off) or stop/TP/time. Disconfirmer 1: if RSI-overbought ALONE does as well, the funding-froth leg adds nothing and this is a naive overbought fade (which historically gets run over). Disconfirmer 2: this overlaps funding-contrarian-crash-filter (both fade crowded-long froth) — if dropping RSI for the runup filter gives the same result they are the same spec; RSI must add distinct over-extension information. Disconfirmer 3: shorting crypto means a perp venue + borrow/funding cost — net of perp fees AND the funding the short PAYS while frothy, the pullback must still clear the round-trip. Disconfirmer 4: a powered FAIL here is informative — crypto's upward drift makes systematic shorts hard, so this tests whether the leverage-confirmed fade survives where a naive one doesn't. tier0 funding + price/TA features.
catalyst: RSI overbought WHILE funding is frothy-positive — an over-extended, over-levered top to fade
